unverified_and_limitations: Authenticated account login, 2FA, and account-gated downloads (Windscribe Pro generator, Surfshark WireGuard, Proton OpenVPN/WireGuard) require real user credentials and remain Unverified.
Real end-to-end VPN tunnel connectivity (handshake + routed traffic) requires valid paid service credentials and an isolated test environment and remains Unverified.
Windows 10/11 native .exe build cannot be cross-compiled on Linux by PyInstaller; run scripts\build_windows.bat on Windows or trigger .github/workflows/test-and-build.yml.

The existing Linux executable in dist/MultiVPNConfigManager/ predates the product rename. Rebuild with scripts/build_linux.sh --skip-browser-bundle to produce dist/VPNConfigDownloader/, or omit --skip-browser-bundle to embed Playwright Chromium.
Proton VPN restricts unauthenticated server catalog scraping; server selection requires manual portal interaction.
Windscribe IKEv2, Stealth, and WStunnel remain Experimental and depend on user-supplied verified endpoints and external clients.
